whyItMatters: go code selects SHA-1 (h := sha1.New()), whose collisions defeat security reliance on the resulting digest.
actions: Replace the SHA-1 selection with sha256.New() wherever the digest is security-relevant.
For remaining interop uses, add a comment stating SHA-1 is intentional.
Re-run the scan and confirm every remaining hit carries that justification.
verification: Rescan shows no unjustified SHA-1 selection, and security digests verify under the replacement.
